_about: Which version of a record wins and what a placed object is, as OpenMW resolves them; run by viewer-shell/ordercore's tests and tests/test_record_index.py. Each case is a load order: `plugins` in order, each a list of [tag, id, deleted]. `expect.live` is every live record as [tag, lower-case id, [defining plugin indices, the last winning]], sorted; `expect.placed` maps a lower-case id to the type a placed object of it is (null: none). Rules: every type is kept on its own; within a type the last plugin wins and a deletion takes the record out; a placed object is the object type whose tag is greatest as a little-endian number (in effect by its last letter), not the one loaded last.

cases.name: the last plugin wins within a type
one id as two object types: both live, the tag decides what is placed
loaded the other way round, the same type is placed
NPC_ outranks every other object type
a leveled item list outranks a leveled creature list
a deletion takes the record out, and the other type is placed
defined again after a deletion: only the plugins after it count
types that are not objects are kept but never placed
an object type and another type: the object is placed
